facts.label: Present perfect e passado
facts.sub: Sem tempo definido: have bought. Com tempo definido: bought yesterday. Pergunte Have you ever…? e When did you…?

facts.label: Present perfect
facts.sub: Use have + particípio quando o resultado importa e o momento não: I have bought a card. Há uma ligação com agora. Não diga quando aconteceu com este tempo.

facts.label: Passado simples
facts.sub: Use o passado simples quando disser o momento: I bought it yesterday. Palavras como yesterday, last month, in 2020 pedem o passado simples. A ação terminou e não há ligação com agora.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “I have bought a card” does not say when.
We say “I have bought it yesterday”.
items.why: With yesterday, use I bought it yesterday.

items.s: “Have you ever…?” uses the present perfect.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “I have bought a card” does not say when. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I have bought it yesterday”. → Falso (With yesterday, use I bought it yesterday.)
“Have you ever…?” uses the present perfect. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A surprise by mail · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot Thursday morning in Houston. Dot stands in line at the post office. Her sister has a birthday next week. Dot wants the card to arrive on time. Leo comes in with a small box under his arm. They ask each other what they have already done.

“I have bought a card for my sister, but I haven’t written it yet.” says Dot. “When did you buy it? I thought you had no time.” says Leo. “I bought it yesterday at a small shop near the post office.” says Dot.
